source: an auto-run script made its scratch folder with a bare mktemp -d, in /tmp
prompt: You are writing a pull request that adds a shell script to the auto-run skill. Any agent of a run may start the script, from any folder and with no PR folder of its own. While it runs, it writes a few files to a scratch folder and removes them at the end. Give the line of the script that makes its scratch folder.
good: `work=$(mktemp -d "${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/sync-check.XXXXXX") || exit 1`, then `trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT` to remove it at the end.
bad: `work=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1`, then `trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT` to remove it at the end.
